description: prHourlyLimit and prConcurrentLimit are 0 (unlimited) on purpose. Renovate's defaults are 2 PRs per hour and 10 concurrent, and this bot runs once a day, so a backlog surfaces only two PRs per run: 8 queued updates took four days to appear, two at a time. That reads as 'a new wave of PRs every few days' when in fact they were queued the whole time and nothing new was released. home2673923/automation has run with both at 0 for a long time and drains its queue in a single run.
